purpose: Checkbox 多选框; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCheckbox](../../lib/src/components/inputs.dart), [IslandCheckboxGroup](../../lib/src/components/selection.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Controlled commits immediately paint complete mark, fill and boundary. Rejected proposals do not start selected motion;600ms outer splash is decoration, with no partial necessary mark.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. Radio and Checkbox groups expose optional spacing: a finite nonnegative gap, default16 horizontally and12 vertically. The same gap governs wrapped rows; selection and focus ownership remain unchanged. Gallery supplies20 for the first controlled example, uses the existing demo surface and the recorded initial values. Single-line Input hints remain single-line with adornments; maxLines explicitly governs multiline hints.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.
